text: Upstream LiteRT-LM's Conversation.handleToolCalls (base df6df5b8, same in v0.18.0) skips a tool call whose arguments are not a JSON object and rethrows any tool error as toolExecutionError; in both of our wrappers (shipped 85b1a776, agello-next 7b872544) missing or null arguments become {}, a JSON string holding an object is decoded, any other argument value gets an error response, and ToolError.notFound, DecodingError and other thrown errors become error messages the model reads instead of ending the turn.

text: Google's LiteRT commit bd326784 (2026-10-14, 'Write host data in place on unlock for CPU-visible Metal buffers') makes LiteRtUnlockMetalMemory, after a write lock on a non-packed tensor whose storage is kBuffer or kImageBuffer in a shared-storage MTLBuffer, memcpy the ML Drift-converted data straight into the buffer instead of calling UploadDescriptorData (which our base ca21dc99 calls on every write unlock of a non-packed tensor; read-locked unlocks return early and packed buffers use WriteDataToBuffer). It still converts first, while our LiteRT commits e17213ea (reads) and 584f3461 (writes) copy linear-buffer tensors directly without the conversion when the host element type matches the GPU tensor's; bd326784 is neither in our base nor in LiteRT 9b8c7f77, the commit upstream LiteRT-LM main d87575de pins.
